narrative: On the tables. The writing-tables open beside an empty supper trencher. One line, small. No chart in the frame. On the tables. The same leaf. No ship-number under the line. The sixpence is not written. The pencil is still.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and did not add a figure.

entities.name: tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in The further, the surer
